erin_devex: Heads-up — during quickstart onboarding the sampleapp's logs drop request-id after an auth retry when DEBUG->INFO toggle happens. Repro below.

raj_infra: repro steps?

erin_devex: 1) start sampleapp with env: OTEL_TRACES=1 LOG_LEVEL=debug 2) hit /api/stream -> auth fails once then retries 3) logs switch to info and reqid missing for subsequent logs. Happens on node & python.

jamie_runtime: can you paste the raw logs? also which SDK versions?

erin_devex: logs: 
```
[DEBUG] 2026-03-22T14:01:12Z req=abc123 middleware auth retry=1 fingerprint=...
[INFO ] 2026-03-22T14:01:12Z starting request handler
[INFO ] 2026-03-22T14:01:12Z user=42 action=call   <-- NO req field
```

erin_devex: Node sdk @1.4.0, python @0.9.2. OTEL hook installed via our quickstart: require('redwood-otel').init() after logger init.

lin_sre: sounds like hook ordering/race. If init runs after logger level flip sampler might strip context keys. Try setting OTEL_INIT_BEFORE_LOGGER=true as a workaround.

kai_ml: could be redaction sampler ran when level changed and removed reqid because it thought it's PII. Check redact config.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline #pr-58 succeeded — sampleapp@staging updated

raj_infra: also try env REDACT_KEEP_FIELDS=req_id,request_id

erin_devex: confirmed REDACT_KEEP_FIELDS worked locally. Happy path: exported env + put otel init before logger. On Node I had to move require call above winston.configure.

jamie_runtime: we'll add a note in quickstart: recommend OTEL before logger and set keep_fields. Also file bug to evaluate default redact sampler on level changes.

erin_devex: created GH issue #8345 with minimal repro and logs. Thanks all :heart: 

lin_sre: filed internal runbook snippet to avoid this during oncalls.
